name: Criquet
why: Golf shirts in a 1970s style — four-button placket, cotton rather than performance fabric.
origin: Founded in Austin in 2010 by Billy Nachman and Hobson Brown.

onething.n: verified ✓ — the shirt the brand was built on; collection page

notes.golf: Golf is the whole premise rather than a category the brand entered — the Players Shirt is a 1970s tour polo rebuilt, and everything else follows from it.
notes.cotton: Founded on a 100% organic cotton claim. The current Players Shirt is described as 100% premium pima, and the line now includes a 57/43 organic-cotton and polyester performance version — the organic premise has softened as the range grew. Recorded because the two claims are not the same.

notes.craft: Criquet's product copy says 'Designed in Austin, TX' and almost always just 'Imported'; only the Quilted Hoodie names a country (Peru), and no factory or mill is named anywhere I read. That is a country of make, stated rarely: a 2, not the current 3, unless the unread polo pages name a mill or maker. [audit proposed 2 at low confidence; held at 3 pending a second read]

cities: No store of its own in the US · independent menswear shops, and its own site
